title: Calendar popup becomes large when events pane appears, but does not get smaller when it disappears
line: The clock's calendar popup shrinks back to its normal size when you turn off the Holidays or other event plugins.
explanation: Every applet popup wrote its current size to the config when it closed, and a size read back from the config is treated as the user's choice, so it is never recalculated. The clock popup has to grow to 45 grid units for the events pane; that forced size was saved and kept, so after turning the plugins off the popup stayed wide (even after a restart), and in the same session nothing shrank it either because a smaller minimum never resized the popup. Now the popup forgets the stored size when it closes at exactly its automatic size, and while it has no remembered size it recalculates its size when its minimum changes, so it shrinks back. A size the user picks by dragging the edges is still remembered.

commits.message:
AppletPopup: don't remember a size the popup picked by itself

The popup saved its size whenever it closed, so a size it only grew to
for a temporary minimum, like the clock's events pane, stuck for good.
Now only sizes that differ from the automatic one are remembered.

BUG: 465063

media.caption: Holidays on: the popup grows for the Events pane (tester, pure master)
Holidays off again: the popup stays wide with a stretched calendar
Holidays off, after restarting plasmashell: still wide
Holidays on: the popup still grows for the Events pane
Holidays off again: the popup is back to its calendar-only size
Holidays on, popup closed, Holidays off, plasmashell restarted: normal size
